# Third-party material

Files in this folder are other projects' work, included unmodified under their own licenses. [NOTICE](../NOTICE) lists each one with its copyright line.

| Folder | What | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fonts/inter` | Inter 4.1, weights 400, 500, 600 and 700 | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/source-serif-4` | Source Serif 4 (version 4.005), weights 400, 600 and 700 | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono` | JetBrains Mono 2.304, weights 400, 500, 600 and 700 | OFL-1.1 |
| `lucide` | The license of the Lucide icon set (version 1.62.0), whose shapes are in `spec/data/icons.json` | ISC, with MIT for some icons |

Source Serif 4 has no static weight 500 at its default optical size. Where the specification asks for serif at weight 500, the Regular (400) file and its metrics are used.

Each file's SHA-256 is pinned in `spec/generators/inputs.lock.json`, with the release it came from.
